## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger, what changed for users, and any compatibility impact.

## Validation

List checks actually performed. Distinguish isolated tests from live account verification; include only sanitized evidence.

- [ ] Relevant isolated tests pass
- [ ] Formatting and publication checks pass
- [ ] English/Chinese documentation matches behavior changes
- [ ] No credentials, cookie exports, account databases or private responses are included
- [ ] Writes remain opt-in and uncertain outcomes do not retry automatically

## Limits or follow-ups

Include material limits, known upstream failures and focused follow-up work, if any.
